description: Roads is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Garfield County, Colorado road network, including state & federal highways, county roads, city streets, other local roads open to the public, and private roads and trails. Updated 12-31-2013. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category County. Its tags are garfield, street, trail, road, highway. The table has 80 columns. Attribution on the portal: Garfield County IT. The portal shows 2015-03-12 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
